intro: Lake Elune'ara is the shimmering, sacred body of water that occupies the heart of Moonglade. Revering the Moon Goddess Elune, the lake serves as a place of spiritual reflection for the Cenarion Circle, though deep within its murky floor lies the dormant, corrupted demigod Omen.

p: Framed by the moonlit groves of Moonglade, Lake Elune'ara provides serene waters said to be blessed by the White Lady herself. The lake lies at the spiritual center of the druidic haven, bordered by Nighthaven to the north and the shrine grounds of the Cenarion Circle. Initiates have long plumbed its tranquil depths to retrieve long-lost relics, attuning themselves to the currents of nature as they seek harmony with the land.

Despite the tranquility on the surface, ancient peril rests beneath the gentle ripples. Centuried legends speak of the two-headed wolf demigod Omen, a revered ancient corrupted by the Burning Legion during the War of the Ancients. Defeated and cast into the lake bed long ago, Omen slumbers deep below the dark waters, an enduring reminder of nature's wounds.
